dialogues.jp: 心の中でアクセルから足をはなす。

背後に吸い込まれるようにして流れていた背景
が、ゆっくりとした流れのものに変わる。
dialogues.en: The passing surroundings slowed down too.
dialogues.text: The passing surroundings slowed down too.

dialogues.jp:
加速と減速をスムーズに繰り返し、コーナーを
無駄なく曲がって、ようやく校門が目視できる
所まで来たのだ。
dialogues.en:
I adjusted my speed up and down to make smooth turns round
the corners, and I finally got close enough to see the
school gate.
dialogues.text:
I adjusted my speed up and down to make smooth turns round
the corners, and I finally got close enough to see the
school gate.

dialogues.jp: 「なんとかなりそうだな」
dialogues.en: "I think I can make it in time."
dialogues.text: "I think I can make it in time."

dialogues.jp: 今日も最後尾からの逆転劇。
dialogues.en: I passed so many students on the way again today.
dialogues.text: I passed so many students on the way again today.

dialogues.jp: 「超音速の騎士と呼んでくれ」
人のいない桜並木を歩く。
dialogues.en: I walked down the street with the cherry blossom trees.
dialogues.text: I walked down the street with the cherry blossom trees.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉〜っ」
背後から、眞子の声と駆け足が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I heard Mako's voice and her footsteps from behind me.
dialogues.text: I heard Mako's voice and her footsteps from behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんた……速いわね」

振り返ると、へばった顔の眞子がひざに手をつ
いて俺を見上げていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around to see an exhausted Mako bending over and
holding onto her knees.
dialogues.text:
I turned around to see an exhausted Mako bending over and
holding onto her knees.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「途中で見かけたのに……ぜんぜん追いつけな
　いんだもん」
dialogues.en: "I saw you a way back...... but I couldn't catch up to you."
dialogues.text: "I saw you a way back...... but I couldn't catch up to you."

dialogues.jp: ようやく膝から手を離し、背を伸ばす。
dialogues.en: She let go of her knees and straightened her back.
dialogues.text: She let go of her knees and straightened her back.

dialogues.jp: 「ところで萌先輩は？」
眞子の後ろの道には、萌先輩の姿はなかった。
dialogues.en: There was no sign of Moe-sempai behind her.
dialogues.text: There was no sign of Moe-sempai behind her.

dialogues.jp:
俺につられて加速した眞子に、置いてきぼりで
も食らったか。
dialogues.en: Did she leave Moe-sempai behind in order to catch up to me?
dialogues.text: Did she leave Moe-sempai behind in order to catch up to me?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「準備に手間取ってたんで先に出てきた」
dialogues.en: "I left her at home as she was slow getting ready."
dialogues.text: "I left her at home as she was slow getting ready."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「おいおい」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「しょうがないでしょう。ほんとに遅いんだか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "I can't help it. She's really slow."
dialogues.text: "I can't help it. She's really slow."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いいじゃないか、待ってあげても。遅刻の１
　回や２回、どうってことないって。俺が保証
　する」
dialogues.en:
"You can wait for her. It's not a big deal to be late once
or twice. I guarantee you."
dialogues.text:
"You can wait for her. It's not a big deal to be late once
or twice. I guarantee you."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「言葉の重みが違うわね」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まぁな」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「でもクラス委員長が遅刻するわけにもいかな
　いでしょう？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「俺は気にしないけど」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたの意見は全てにおいて除外」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それにあたしは３ヵ年皆勤賞がかかってんの
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm also up for the award for three years of perfect
attendance."
dialogues.text:
"I'm also up for the award for three years of perfect
attendance."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ」
いるんだな、そういうやつ。
「なるほど。馬鹿は風邪ひか……」
dialogues.en:
"I see. I heard a proverb before that 'only an idiot doesn't
catch a cold'......"
dialogues.text:
"I see. I heard a proverb before that 'only an idiot doesn't
catch a cold'......"

dialogues.jp: ゴスッ――
「ぐほっ……」
バタッ――

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、急がないと」
眞子の駆け足が遠ざかる。
dialogues.en: Mako's footsteps were getting further away.
dialogues.text: Mako's footsteps were getting further away.

dialogues.jp: ま、待て眞子……。

地面に手をつこうとするが、身体が言うことを
きかない。
dialogues.en: I tried to get up, but my body didn't respond.
dialogues.text: I tried to get up, but my body didn't respond.

dialogues.jp: ぐふっ……。
◆３ヵ年皆勤賞◆

学園へ向かっていると、後ろから眞子がやって
来た。
dialogues.en: Mako caught up to me on the way to school.
dialogues.text: Mako caught up to me on the way to school.

dialogues.jp:
眞子は何でも、３ヵ年皆勤賞を狙っているらし
い。やれやれ、優等生ですな。
dialogues.en:
She said she's up for the award for three years of perfect
attendance. She's such a prefect student.
dialogues.text:
She said she's up for the award for three years of perfect
attendance. She's such a prefect student.
